name: ADA water closet, floor mount
clearanceBasis: ASSUMPTION (not a code determination), after ADA 604.3: clearance 60 in wide (1.52 m, perpendicular to side wall) x 56 in deep (1.42 m) for a wall-hung or floor-mount water closet. Sides 0.56 m approximates the 60 in minus the fixture; side clearance 0.56 m is the 1.52 m (60 in) width minus the fixture, split.

provenance.origin: ADA 604 water closet class (0.41 x 0.71 x 0.76 m, seat 17 to 19 in)
provenance.notes: Fixture plus tank; clearance front is 56 in (ADA 604.3.1). Dimensions are a class estimate, not a measurement; replace with a spec sheet or tape measure before purchase.
